spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded by `max_turns` (turn budget) with an explicit `stop_reason` (`submitted` / `turn_limit` / `model_error` / `no_tool_call`)
spec_features.evidence: subject/tool_loop.py:42 `max_turns = env.task.max_turns or config.max_turns`; line 45 `stop_reason = "turn_limit"`; line 47 `for turn in range(max_turns):` actually bounds the loop and ends the rollout when exhausted; `stop_reason` set to "submitted" (line ~88 on submit break) and "model_error" (on exception break). config/config.py:16 `max_turns: int = 12`. The cap is checked and terminates execution end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Core claim fully enforced: the loop is genuinely bounded by max_turns and stop_reason is recorded. One discrepancy from the quoted list: of the four stop_reason values, `no_tool_call` is only logged as an event type (tool_loop.py:69) and the loop merely `continue`s after a single nudge rather than ending; it is never assigned to stop_reason. The docstring 'nudge once then end if it repeats' is not actually implemented (it nudges every time, never ends on repeat). Still, the bounded-turns hard stop itself is fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 12  # tool-loop turns before forced stop
